codeReview.summary: The OperationSorter enhancement successfully implements FK-based topological sorting using Kahn's algorithm. The implementation correctly reads parent-child relationships from the avileo.ts preset config and builds a dependency graph to ensure parent entities are processed before children. Backward compatibility with syncGroupId-based sorting is maintained as a fallback when no FK dependencies exist.

VAL-1-001.evidence: Test 'places sale before sale_items when sale_items references sale via FK' verifies that a sale with entityId 'sale_123' is sorted before sale_items with payload.sale_id: 'sale_123'. The test passes and confirms the FK-based topological sort works correctly.
testNames: places sale before sale_items when sale_items references sale via FK
handles multiple items referencing the same parent sale
respects FK references even when timestamps suggest otherwise

VAL-1-002.evidence: Multiple tests verify multi-parent dependency resolution: sale_items with 3 parents (sales, products, product_variants), abonos with 2 parents (customers, sales), visitas with 2 parents (distribuciones, customers), and customer_tags with 2 parents (customers, tags). All tests confirm children are placed after ALL parents.
testNames: places sale_items after all three parents (sales, products, product_variants)
handles abonos with two parents (customers, sales)
handles visitas with two parents (distribuciones, customers)
handles customer_tags with two parents (customers, tags)

VAL-1-004.evidence: Three tests verify backward compatibility: operations WITH syncGroupId still sort correctly, mixed batches (some with syncGroupId, some without) are handled properly, and fallback to syncGroupId sorting occurs when no FK dependencies exist.
testNames: sorts operations WITH syncGroupId correctly (legacy support)
handles mixed batch with some having syncGroupId and some without
falls back to syncGroupId sorting when no FK dependencies exist

sharedStateObservations.observation: The backend-worker skill was followed correctly. The worker enhanced OperationSorter with FK-based topological sorting, maintained backward compatibility, and added comprehensive tests. All validation assertions (VAL-1-001, VAL-1-002, VAL-1-004) are fulfilled.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff shows 11 new tests added covering FK-based topological sort, multi-parent dependencies, backward compatibility, and circular dependency handling. All 22 tests in operation-sorter.test.ts pass.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The implementation correctly uses the relation config from presets/avileo.ts to determine FK relationships. The parentMap is built from config.relations.parents, and findParentRefs extracts FK values from operation payloads.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: packages/drizzle-sync/src/server/operation-sorter.ts lines 25-50 show buildParentMap() and findParentRefs() functions using avileoEntities config.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The topological sort implementation uses Kahn's algorithm with cycle detection. When cycles exist (shouldn't happen in practice), it gracefully falls back to timestamp-based tiebreaking for remaining nodes.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: packages/drizzle-sync/src/server/operation-sorter.ts lines 83-158 show the topologicalSort function with in-degree calculation, queue processing, and cycle handling.

summary: The m1-enhance-operation-sorter feature is complete and passes all validation assertions. The OperationSorter now supports FK-based topological sorting that ensures parent entities (sales, customers, products) are processed before child entities (sale_items, abonos, visitas) based on FK references in payloads. The implementation correctly reads parent-child relationships from presets/avileo.ts, uses Kahn's algorithm for topological sorting, handles multi-parent dependencies (up to 3 parents), maintains backward compatibility with syncGroupId-based sorting as fallback, and gracefully handles circular dependencies with timestamp-based tiebreaking. All 22 tests pass including 11 new tests specifically for this feature.
